title: Hypergraph independence bounds: from maximum degree to average degree
summary: We prove a transfer theorem for hereditary classes of $(r+1)$-uniform hypergraphs. Let $\mathcal H$ be such a class, and for $H\in\mathcal H$ write $Δ(H)$ and $d(H)$ for the maximum degree and average degree of $H$, respectively. We show that, for every nearly logarithmic function $f$ in the sense defined below, a maximum-degree lower bound for the independence number of the form \[ α(H)\ge (1-o(1))\frac{f(Δ(H))}{Δ(H)^{1/r}}|V(H)| \qquad\text{as }Δ(H)\to\infty \] for all $H\in\mathcal H$ implies the corresponding average-degree lower bound \[ α(H)\ge (1-o(1))\frac{f(d(H))}{d(H)^{1/r}}|V(H)|…
